description: Ganoderma / BSR risk classification dataset manifest

sources.name: Oil Palm Ganoderma Infected Dataset
sources.notes: Root-level photography. Ganoderma=1 or Ganoderma Fungus=1 => suspected_risk. Exact dataset version, license, and source page require teammate confirmation.

sources.name: Oil Palm Healthy Dataset
sources.notes: Root-level photography. healthy=1 => healthy, unhealthy=1 => suspected_risk. Exact dataset version, license, and source page require teammate confirmation.

label_notes: v1 conservative labels. Without expert or lab confirmation, all risk labels are 'suspected', never 'confirmed'. Future expansion may add: suspected_early, moderate, severe, dead_or_collapsed.

split_strategy.constraint: Stratified split per class to preserve class balance across splits
split_strategy.notes: Current v1 handoff appears to use stratified random/source-limited split. Grouped tree, plantation, video, or capture-batch leakage has not been ruled out.

notes: Both datasets are root-level photography for consistency
Both importers output to the same classification/ directory
other_stress_unknown class is reserved for future use; no images in v1
Ganoderma risk is NEVER confirmed without expert evidence
Offline v1 metrics are recorded but not integrated into AI Engine runtime
